capabilities: create scatter, line, and bar chart views in a Base
select properties or formulas for the X axis
choose Y axis properties from the Base's Properties menu
split data into multiple charts by group or by property
extras: Installation is currently only via BRAT; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: adds three new bases views: Scatter Charts, Line Charts, and Bar Charts
problem: Obsidian Bases has no built-in chart views, so note data cannot be visualized as scatter, line, or bar charts inside a Base.
summary: Adds three new Bases views — scatter, line, and bar charts — for plotting note properties and formulas.
